settings.title: Settings
settings.systemManagedHint: Update this system FFmpeg installation with Homebrew or your operating system package manager.
settings.cliManagedHint: This executable was supplied for the current session with a command-line flag and is not modified by the app.
settings.ffmpegDesc: Required to merge audio and video, convert formats, embed metadata, and process subtitles
settings.toolUpdateConfirm: Current version: {current}. Latest version: {latest}. Update now?
settings.ytdlpDesc: Core tool required for this application
settings.denoDesc: YouTube requires a JavaScript runtime to parse video information
settings.youtubeAdvancedDesc: PO Token and visitor_data help bypass YouTube 403 errors and rate-limiting on certain videos. Leave blank if not needed. See yt-dlp wiki: Extractors > YouTube > PO Token Guide.
settings.proxyDesc: Forward download requests through a proxy server. Address and port are required.
settings.proxyInvalid: Please fill in the proxy address
settings.pathResolveModeHint: System Preferred: detect via PATH and fall back to the app-managed copy. App Only: always use the version inside the app data directory.
settings.defaultFfmpegArgsHint: Applied to every newly parsed video. You can still override the value for an individual task.
settings.aboutDesc: A yt-dlp GUI built with Tauri 2 + Vue 3 + Naive UI
settings.appIsLatest: You are on the latest version
settings.systemBinaryNotice: Currently using the system-installed yt-dlp. "Check Update" only updates the app-managed copy. Switch the path mode to "App Only" for updates to take effect.

cookie.desc: Paste Netscape-format cookie text manually; each link is matched to a profile by its domain.
cookie.autoHint: Paste a link to see which cookie profile matches
cookie.noMatch: No cookie profile matched, so no cookies will be sent
cookie.invalidFormat: Not a complete Netscape cookie file; check the header and the 7 tab-separated fields on each line
cookie.noDomainDetected: No domain could be detected in the content
cookie.domainsHint: Domains used for automatic matching. A rule such as example.com also matches all of its subdomains, and you can edit the list freely.
cookie.domainsRequired: Keep at least one matching domain
cookie.enabledHint: Enabled (only enabled profiles take part in automatic matching)
cookie.deleteConfirm: Delete this cookie profile? Tasks that used it will stop sending cookies.
cookie.testerPlaceholder: Paste a download link to check which profile is used
cookie.profileMissing: The cookie profile no longer exists
cookie.verificationDesc: This site requires sign-in. Configure a cookie profile in settings first.
cookie.invalidFormatLine: Line {line} is not valid: each cookie line needs 7 tab-separated fields
cookie.tooManyCookies: Too many cookies, or the content is too large
cookie.domainPlaceholder: Enter a domain and press Enter, e.g. youtube.com
cookie.noDomains: No matching domain yet; add at least one
cookie.contentKeepHint: Cookie content is not shown again after saving. Keep the box empty to preserve the current content, or paste new content to overwrite it.
cookie.textPlaceholderKeep: Leave empty to keep the current cookies; paste new Netscape-format text to overwrite
